nodes.hint: FEM runs are heavy; for regular work connect your own server
nodes.hintTip: Your own server runs your jobs with the same solver version. It connects out over HTTPS, so there are no ports to open, and its CPU time does not count against fair use.

share.label: Share idle time with MOTRES
share.tip: Off by default. When on, MOTRES may run its own jobs on this node while you have nothing queued: only MOTRES catalog work (for example passport computations of catalog motors) that an admin marked shareable, signed and version-pinned like your own jobs. Never the job of another customer, never confidential or NDA data. Shared jobs run at the lowest priority (nice 19, idle IO) within the core and RAM caps below. Your own jobs always go first: a shared job stops within seconds when you submit one, and is re-queued, not failed.
share.capsTip: Default: half of the cores and half of the RAM.
share.stopTip: Turns sharing off and ends the MOTRES job running on this node within seconds; the job is re-queued elsewhere.

rule.fallback: if not converged: retry with damping {damping}, max {max}
rule.steps: scan {n} speeds + both sides of each grid breakpoint → bisect each pass/fail edge to {tol} {unit} → take the upper edge of the highest passing band
rule.lastNot: last run: NOT converged, {n} / {max} iterations used
rule.stopExtra: Between passes the bearing seat must also move less than {bearing} K and the impulse-duty ratio less than {duty} point.

ruleTip.thermal_fixed_point: Each pass takes the current that makes the shaft torque at the magnet temperature, re-checks the voltage, evaluates the losses at the winding temperature and solves the thermal network; the new winding and magnet temperatures go back into the next pass. Damping starts at {start} and is halved (not below {min}) while the residual stalls. If the first run does not settle, one more run starts with damping {fbDamping} and up to {fbMax} iterations; only then is the point called not converged.
ruleTip.speed_search: The speed is the variable: every speed runs the whole chain on the left. The scan covers {scan} speeds plus both sides of every speed where the passport grids change; every pass/fail edge is bisected to {rpmTol} rpm ({passes} refinement passes). The S1 limit is the upper edge of the highest passing band; if the scan ends still passing the limit is only a lower bound.
ruleTip.em_thermal_module: The electromagnetic loss field is solved at a winding temperature; the thermal solve returns a new winding temperature, which is fed back (relaxation {start}) until it moves less than {tol} {unit}, at most {max} passes. Losses go one way, temperatures the other.
ruleTip.em_thermal_orchestrator: The electromagnetic run gives the loss map, the thermal solve gives coil, magnet and bearing temperatures, which become the next run's operating temperatures. Converged when they move less than {tol} {unit} between passes (at most {max} passes). Losses go one way, temperatures the other.
ruleTip.design_search: The optimizer proposes a parameter set, the geometry and mesh are built and the FEM confirms it; the result guides the next proposal. The number of evaluations is set per run.
